newsitem.title: USA: ComEd fully restores 794 MW Dresden 2 unit.
newsitem.headline: ComEd fully restores 794 MW Dresden 2 unit.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 2 nuclear unit resumed full production following repair and testing of its turbine control valves, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The unit, in Morris, Ill., was generating electricity at reduced capacity for about two weeks.
The nearby Dresden 3, with identical capacity rating, is scheduled to return to operation January 10 after being shut October 26 for maintenance, NRC said.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
